name: Manchester Metropolitan University
description: Manchester Metropolitan University is one of the most extensive higher education centers in Europe with 38,000 students and more than 1,000 undergraduate, postgraduate and professional courses. Manchester Metropolitan achieved the silver award in the Teaching Excellence Framework, has 85% of research impact rated world-leading and internationally excellent as judged in the REF, is the UK’s greenest university as ranked by the People and Planet sustainability league tables. The University is in the top 200 global universities under 50 years old as ranked by the Times Higher Education. Manchester is one of the most popular student cities in the UK. Timestamps Updated
